**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **§ 4.1 Charges** contains only a mechanical pricing provision (charges specified in Service Option Attachments/Order Forms, invoiced as they begin or fall due) — no obligation for Bluefly to give IBM terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no obligation to match competing offers.
- Targeted searches for MFN indicia ("no less favorable/favourable", "most favored", "best price", "parity", third-party terms) surfaced nothing that burdens us; the only third-party references are indemnity, liability, confidentiality and no-third-party-beneficiary provisions.
- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** ("Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.") reinforces the absence of any exclusivity or pricing-parity commitment.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN burdening the Customer). There is also no vendor-granted MFN in our favour, but the playbook treats that as welcome rather than required, so it is noted only and not flagged.
